name: B10-0435/2026 – After recital D – Am 1
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the state of play of advancing EU-Africa trade and investment relations
part_text: Da. whereas the EU’s trade and investment strategy should contribute to Africans having the freedom to choose to remain in their nations and contribute to their growth without being forced to abandon them; whereas those forced to abandon their nations often pay unscrupulous traffickers to risk their lives attempting to cross the Mediterranean Sea;
